name: r026.living_npc_package_v001_mcw
description: Current-source R-026 living-base package route: start from the audited established-base fixture and use only current native semantic owners to bind free-text recipient selection, ambient LLM handling, snapshots, and basecamp request context.

steps.label: operate_living_npc_package
steps.objective: Use only advertised native semantic actions to submit one bounded follower free-text utterance, observe the actual recipient and response/snapshot record, then exercise one ambient route and one basecamp request-context route when their current recipients are independently observable.
proof_targets: bound native receipts for every player operation
actual follower and ambient recipient identity
LLM request snapshots and response records
basecamp request-context record when the established-base actor routes there
save/reload evidence only if the observed route changes persisted state
invariants: fixture installation and startup receive zero feature credit
recipient identity is read from the same-run native log or snapshot, never inferred from a label
ambient and follower results keep independent verdicts
basecamp routing requires a current camp-routing record
do not synthesize LLM responses or mutate NPC/camp/save state directly
stop the affected claim at first missing native receipt, source-binding drift, or cleanup failure while retaining independent observations

steps.label: confirm_addressed_craft_save_boundary
steps.abort_reason: the native addressed-craft lifecycle did not leave a readable saved McWilliams world for the declared relaunch owner

steps.label: bind_relaunched_living_base_world
steps.abort_reason: the declared native lifecycle owner did not relaunch the saved McWilliams world into ordinary gameplay

steps.label: observe_persisted_addressed_craft_and_unaddressed_control
steps.objective: Observe the same saved addressed craft-request state after process replacement, then issue one independently receipted unaddressed craft-text control.  Do not restage the fixture or create the addressed request again.
proof_targets: same saved McWilliams world after native process replacement
exact addressed craft-request state remains observable
unaddressed control does not queue the addressed camp-craft request
invariants: relaunch and startup are lifecycle evidence, not request-behavior credit
do not mutate fixture, save, NPC, or camp state directly
retain addressed and unaddressed verdicts independently
